items.title: Pay dental invoice
items.quote: Bitte begleichen Sie den Rechnungsbetrag spätestens 30 Tage nach dem Rechnungsdatum auf das unten angegebene Konto.
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 04.09.2025. The period is '30 Tage nach dem Rechnungsdatum'. Under §187(1) BGB, since the period runs from an event (the invoice date), the day of the event itself is not counted, so counting starts 05.09.2025. A period of 30 days ending on a day designated by number of days after the starting event ends, per §188(1) BGB, 30 days after 04.09.2025 = 04.10.2025. This is a Saturday. This is a civil-law payment obligation between private parties (not an administrative act), so §193 BGB applies: if the last day of a period for performance falls on a Sunday, Saturday, or a public holiday, the period ends on the next working day instead. 05.10.2025 is a Sunday, so the next working day is Monday, 06.10.2025 (no NW public holiday on that date). Therefore the payment is due by 06.10.2025.
